description: A custom Android view extending DefaultTimeBar to create a rounded, pill-shaped seek bar for media playback, with custom drawing of the track segments and thumb. It overrides drawing methods for a Material 3 style appearance and handles syncing with playback position, buffering, and duration.

classes.name: RoundedTimeBar
classes.description: A custom UI component extending DefaultTimeBar for a stylized, rounded media progress bar with a fixed-size thumb and custom segment rendering.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides default drawing to render a rounded track with buffered and played segments, and a custom circular thumb.

methods.name: drawRoundedTrackAndThumb
methods.description: Draws segments of the track with different colors and a fixed-radius thumb based on the current playback position.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Updates the duration of the media and triggers a redraw.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Updates the current playback position and triggers a redraw.

methods.name: setBufferedPosition
methods.description: Updates the buffered position and triggers a redraw.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Creates a color with the specified alpha transparency.

methods.name: toSafeFrac
methods.description: Converts a Long value into a normalized float ratio within [0,1], safely handling division by zero.
